eva.title: Eva Room is bright, welcoming, and designed for those who want to experience Syracuse with more space and comfort.
eva.description1: It features a double bed, a sofa bed, and a balcony with an external view, providing natural light and direct contact with the city.
eva.description2: The private bathroom and well-organized spaces make it ideal for couples, small groups, or families.
eva.description3: The room is equipped with air conditioning, a mini fridge, a kettle, and a TV to offer you independence and convenience throughout your stay.

aria.title: Aria Room is an intimate and relaxing space, designed for those seeking comfort and tranquility.
aria.description1: Equipped with a double bed, sofa bed, and private bathroom, it offers a functional and welcoming environment, perfect for any type of stay.
aria.description2: The balcony with an internal view ensures greater silence and privacy, ideal for truly resting and disconnecting from the city's rhythm.
aria.description3: The presence of air conditioning, a mini fridge, a kettle, and a TV ensures practicality, independence, and moments of relaxation.
aria.amenities: Towels and shower kit included for a complete, worry‑free experience.

giulio.title: Giulio Room is the ideal choice for those seeking tranquility, essentiality, and quality rest.
giulio.description1: Equipped with a comfortable double bed and private bathroom, it is perfect for practical, distraction‑free stays, whether for travel, work, or personal needs.
giulio.description2: The room is fitted with air conditioning, a mini fridge, a kettle, and a TV to ensure comfort and relaxation at any time of the day.
giulio.description3: The environment is cared for, quiet, and functional, ideal for recharging after a day in Syracuse.
giulio.amenities: Towels and shower kit included for a worry‑free stay.
